description.narrative: The 2023 Global State of Democracy report[1] shows that 2022 is the sixth consecutive year in which more countries experienced net declines in democratic processes than net improvements. The current context of autocratisation and social fracture represents an obstacle to sustainable development and the achievement of the SDGs and hightens geopolitical tensions. It also weakens rule of law standards and good governance principles, which are essential for a conducive business environment and Global Gateway investments. In this context, the need to ensure efficiency, coordination and a impact in delivering democracy support is all the greater and urgent. This requires on the one hand the consolidation of the bold and inclusive `Team Europe¿ approach for democracy, gathering European Union (EU) Member States with different experiences and history, capable of developing powerful coalitions to build, protect or support partners¿ democratic systems and practices. It requires on the other hand multilateral initiatives in support to democracy, which are owned and driven by partner countries and civil society, such as the `Open Government Partnership¿ (OGP)[2]. Based on the founding values of the EU and delivering on the EU Action Plan on Human Rights and Democracy (2021-2027) this action aims to: promote and protect democracy and human rights worldwide with actions based on academic evidence; share experiences on democracy support models; build broad alliances to inform international and national policies, programmes and actions; and support open government reforms. The action is the second phase of the Team Europe Democracy and is composed of four components: (1) Resource for democracy research and analysis, including on democracy support; (2) Structured operational network with EU Member States, practitioners and civil society, sharing and pooling resources, helping develop conceptual and operational approaches for democracy support, and building coalitions with like-minded partners, including civil society;(3) Expertise and support to EU Delegations and EU MS to improve their work to support democracy in a Team Europe approach, and (4) Support to governmental and non-governmental reformers to drive progress through open and accountable governance and participatory democracy[1] The Global State of Democracy 2023 (idea.int)[2] Open Government Partnership | Committed to making governments more open, accountable, and responsive to citizens (opengovpartnership.org)
